2608.18558.title: MorphoGP: A Nonparametric Framework for Predicting Equilibrium Beach Profiles Under Tidal Influence
2608.18558.paper_summary: The prediction of equilibrium beach profiles under tidal influence is of fundamental importance for sustainable coastal development, informing shoreline protection strategies and managing coastal ecosystems under changing environmental conditions. However, it remains challenging due to the highly nonlinear interactions among wave, tide, and sedimentary processes. Traditional empirical and numerical models often exhibit limited adaptability across diverse coastal environments, with especially pronounced limitations in beach systems where tidal processes are important . To improve data-driven prediction under these conditions, this study proposes MorphoGP, a unified category-specific Gaussian process framework for predicting equilibrium beach profiles (EBPs) under tidal influence. The framework first introduces a ContourCluster model based on contrastive learning to classify tide-influenced beach morphologies automatically. Within each morphological category, a specialized Gaussian process expert learns statistical associations between environmental descriptors including waves, tides, and sediments and the beach profile's shape. A Gating Net then integrates the outputs of all experts through a probabilistic weighting mechanism to produce the final prediction. Evaluated on data from over 180 beach profiles from tide-influenced coasts along the Chinese coast, MorphoGP achieves improved predictive performance compared with conventional and deep learning models, reducing the test RMSE by about 59.3\% compared with the best baseline and achieving a final RMSE of 0.297 m. The proposed framework provides a physically informed, data-driven tool for equilibrium beach-profile prediction under tidal influence and coastal management, while stronger process-level physical coupling remains an important direction for future development.
2608.18558.paper_summary_zh: 潮汐影響下的平衡海灘輪廓預測對於可持續海岸發展至關重要，能夠指導海岸線保護策略並在不斷變化的環境條件下管理海岸生態系統。<lb/>然而，由於波浪、潮汐和沉積過程之間的高度非線性相互作用，這仍然是一個挑戰。<lb/>傳統的經驗和數值模型在不同的海岸環境中往往適應性有限，尤其是在潮汐過程重要的海灘系統中，這種限制表現得尤為明顯。<lb/>為了改善在這些條件下的數據驅動預測，本研究提出了MorphoGP，一個統一的類別特定高斯過程框架，用於預測潮汐影響下的平衡海灘輪廓（EBPs）。<lb/>該框架首先引入了一個基於對比學習的ContourCluster模型，自動分類受潮汐影響的海灘形態。<lb/>在每個形態類別中，一個專門的高斯過程專家學習環境描述符（包括波浪、潮汐和沉積物）與海灘輪廓形狀之間的統計關聯。<lb/>然後，Gating Net通過概率加權機制整合所有專家的輸出，以生成最終預測。<lb/>在來自中國沿海潮汐影響海岸的180多個海灘輪廓的數據上進行評估，MorphoGP的預測性能相比傳統和深度學習模型有所改善，測試RMSE比最佳基準降低了約59.3\%，最終RMSE達到0.297米。<lb/>所提出的框架為潮汐影響下的平衡海灘輪廓預測和海岸管理提供了一個物理知識驅動的數據工具，而更強的過程層級物理耦合仍然是未來發展的重要方向。
